Kuvitus: kädet painavat jalkapumpun kahv: Illustration: hands push the handle of a foot pump down, and a hose leads air into a bicycle tyre. The lower part of the pump has warmed up, shown by an orange glow and wavy lines.
Kaksi tapaa muuttaa sisäenergiaa (kaavio: Two ways to change internal energy (schematic, not to scale). On the left, a piston is pushed into the cylinder and does work W on the air, and the air particles move faster. On the right, a hot and a cold object touch, and a quantity of heat Q is transferred from the hot one to the cold one.
Energiakaavio: systeemiin tulee lämpömää: Energy diagram: a quantity of heat Q and work W enter the system, and the internal energy of the system changes by their sum. Energy transferred out is negative.
Työn etumerkki (kaaviokuva, ei mittakaav: The sign of work (schematic, not to scale). On the left, the piston is pushed in and the gas is compressed: the surroundings do work on the gas, so W is positive. On the right, the gas pushes the piston out and expands: the gas does work on the surroundings, so W is negative.
